## Professional Summary

Lead Automation Engineer with 10+ years building automation across multi-tenant IT operations and SMB client environments. Built workflow, endpoint, and Microsoft 365 automation across 500+ client environments and 4,000+ endpoints. Recent work includes a production ElevenLabs Conversational AI on-call voice agent deployed across 15 client sites in 5 client organizations, with Twilio/Telnyx/Bandwidth telephony, n8n orchestration, real-time CRM enrichment, schema-validated webhook contracts, and a Vitest + synthetic-conversation regression harness. P95 < 500 ms; 100% call success rate; 92% enrichment success.

## Selected Projects (Public-Facing Evidence)

### On-Call AI Voice Agent System
- Inbound and outbound phone agents handling support, booking, and call routing on ElevenLabs Conversational AI.
- 13-node n8n orchestration; 500 ms latency envelope from inbound call to agent response.
- Twilio/Telnyx/Bandwidth telephony with SMS tool-calling for outbound follow-up.
- Real-time CRM enrichment (lookup, scoring, write-back) during the call.
- Schema-validated webhook contracts at every n8n boundary.
- Agent registry with dynamic variables for per-client customization.
- Vitest + synthetic-conversation evaluation harness with regression detection on every prompt change.
- Deployment, rollback, and health-check scripts; real-time observability dashboard tracking P50/P95/P99 latency.
- Production metrics: P95 < 500 ms; 100% call success rate; 92% enrichment success; measurable booking conversion lift on outbound use cases.

### Custom RAG Chatbots
Retrieval-Augmented Generation bots ingesting client-specific business data, deployed to websites and Slack channels. Grounded answers from client SOPs and documentation with graceful escalation to a human when retrieval confidence falls below threshold; per-client knowledge isolation enforced at the retrieval layer prevents cross-client data leakage in multi-tenant deployments.

### AI Lead Parsers
Agents that read messy inbound emails, extract structured fields (Name, Budget, Sentiment, Intent), and populate CRMs (HubSpot / Salesforce / ServiceTitan) instantly. Stack: Anthropic Claude for high-stakes intent classification, Gemini for high-volume bulk parsing, n8n orchestration, Zod / ArkType schema validation at the LLM boundary. Replaces manual SDR triage and ensures lead context lands in CRM ahead of first-response SLA.

### Smart Scheduling Systems
Logic-heavy calendar workflows handling conflict resolution, payment gating, and Zoom link automation across teams. Built on n8n with deterministic business-rule logic layered on top of LLM-based intake parsing. Integrations: Microsoft 365 (Outlook calendar, Teams), Google Workspace (Calendar), Stripe (payment gating), Zoom (meeting link automation).

### gtm_ops Proposal Console
Lead-to-proposal runtime. Accepts web chat, voice-agent notes, contact forms, webhooks, internal records, or CRM exports. Normalizes the fields, enriches the lead with company details and recent signals, fills typed proposal fields with structured extraction, renders a branded PDF, and writes every step to a replayable run log. Cloudflare-hosted; live demo at app.wranngle.com.

### Voice AI Agent Eval Harness
Open-source test runner and scenario framework for ElevenLabs voice agents. Deterministic synthetic transcripts, latency budgets, prompt versioning, and a scoring rubric for user-facing failures.

### Career Architect
Job evaluation and application-material automation platform. Scans job portals (Greenhouse, Ashby, Lever, USAJOBS, Google Jobs), applies structured scoring, generates tailored PDFs, and maintains tracker/report data contracts. Stack: Node.js, Playwright, Python, JobSpy, MCP servers, GitHub Actions, Anthropic Claude, Gemini.

### Tradingbot
Multi-factor algorithmic trading bot on QuantConnect. Combines technical indicators (EMA crossovers, MACD, RSI, Stochastic, ATR breakouts), fundamental universe filtering, and risk management (Kelly-criterion position sizing, sector caps, PDT compliance, trailing/fixed stops). Modular pure-logic separation from QuantConnect runtime; pytest unit tests; research notebook for hypothesis testing.

## Wranngle Systems LLC

- Name: Wranngle Systems LLC

Wranngle Systems LLC builds AI voice agents, lead capture systems, proposal-generation workflows, and business websites for teams with real customer follow-up.

## Services Offered

### AI Voice Agents
- Core Agent ($250/mo): voice receptionist for overflow and after-hours calls; transcript + lead capture.
- Elite Agent ($500/mo, most popular): voice + web chat + two-way SMS, Cal.com calendar booking, ElevenLabs custom voice identity, priority support.
- Add-on: per-additional-location pricing.

### Business Websites
- Landing Page ($900 one-time, 7 days): one focused page with SEO basics, contact form, and source code included.
- Business Site ($3,500 one-time, 3 weeks): up to 5 pages, headless CMS, analytics, lead routing, performance budget, source code included.

### gtm_ops Proposal Console
- Trial (free for 14 days, 5 proposals): branded PDF generation, demo data, Gemini extraction.
- Plus ($20/mo or $16.67/mo annual): 50 proposals/mo, branded PDFs with logo + colors, custom workspace branding, lead intake forms, full audit log, webhook integration, email support.
- Pro ($99/mo or $82.50/mo annual): unlimited proposals, SSO (Google + Azure AD), team workspaces, role-based access, custom domain, exportable run log, priority support.

## Technical Stack (Production)

- Runtime: Bun (local dev) and Cloudflare Workers (production).
- Frontend: React, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Radix UI, TanStack Query, wouter.
- Backend: Cloudflare Pages Functions for lead capture, checkout, and ticker telemetry.
- Validation: ArkType (`type({...})` syntax) at every API boundary.
- Voice runtime: ElevenLabs Conversational AI with the `<elevenlabs-convai>` web component.
- Telephony: Twilio, Telnyx, Bandwidth.
- Workflow orchestration: n8n (self-hosted) with schema-validated webhook contracts.
- Storage: in-memory MemStorage during dev, edge-stateless production runtime; Cloudflare D1 for gtm_ops.
- Build tooling: Vite (frontend), esbuild (backend bundling).
- Linting: XO with Prettier.
